title: GitHub GITHUB_TOKEN issues:write still blocked PR issue-comment 403; require pull-requests:write for bounded same-owner recovery
root_cause: Actual workflow run 39811993147 on merged main 01af9f2 issued /issues/4656/comments POST and returned 403 Resource not accessible by integration. Runner's token had Issues:write and PullRequests:read. GitHub issue github/rest-api-description#6994 confirms real PR timeline comment needs PullRequests:write for this token integration behavior.
impact: The newly merged same-owner failed-gate handoff aborts early; GitHub required dispatch of #4662 succeeded first, but later failed-gate repair signals are not delivered.
failed_approaches: Relying on Issues:write alone to post comments to pull-request timelines
Treating exact-head green Required and CodeQL as runtime comment authorization proof
Declaring the five-minute watchdog live-healthy without provider run logs
fix: In the existing Required Gate Watchdog only, grant pull-requests:write alongside issues:write while retaining action dispatch and contents read; preserve same scheduler and idempotent owner markers.
prevention_rule: For any GitHub Actions workflow writing PR timeline comments, enforce exact job token PR write permission, regression negative canary for read-only PR scope, and verify an actual successful provider comment readback before PROVEN.
outcome: CANDIDATE, no deployed or autonomous source repair claim

negative_canary: Disable CLS/CodeQL or original scheduler -> regression fails
